anomalies.description: Large crowd engaged in violent unrest with mounted police (in yellow vests) attempting to control or disperse the crowd; individuals are seen running, falling, and clashing amid debris-strewn street; a police car is present early on but quickly overwhelmed; sustained chaotic movement and physical confrontation between groups.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat observed among individuals in the crowd, including grappling, pushing, and striking; some involve mounted officers engaging with civilians, consistent with active fighting rather than mere crowd pressure.
In frames f3–f5, two individuals appear to be engaged in close physical struggle near the center-left of the frame, with one person seemingly pulling or grappling the other amid smoke and movement.

A chaotic street scene with smoke, multiple individuals running, and mounted police (in yellow high-visibility jackets) advancing into a crowd; civilians appear to be fleeing or engaging in disorderly conduct, consistent with violent unrest.

In frames f6–f8, a person in a red cap appears to be striking or pushing a fallen or crouching individual on the ground while mounted police are nearby; the victim appears unable to effectively resist.

Group of mounted police in high-visibility jackets confront a crowd in a smoky, chaotic street environment; civilians are seen running and scattering, indicating collective unrest and violent confrontation.

The scene shows a chaotic street confrontation involving multiple uniformed personnel and a crowd; the intensity, number of participants, and use of shields and force indicate collective violent unrest beyond isolated fighting.; Nighttime street scene with large group of people moving rapidly, some appearing to flee or confront authorities; ambient lighting suggests ongoing unrest after initial clash.

Multiple individuals in police-style helmets and dark uniforms are engaged in physical struggle with a person on the ground; they appear to be restraining or subduing them using coordinated force, including grabbing limbs and applying pressure.

An individual is on the ground while multiple officers apply force (grappling, pressing down); the person appears restrained and unable to resist, suggesting attack on a helpless victim during the arrest/subduing process.

A person is lying on the ground while multiple officers continue to apply force, including what appears to be striking or pressing down on the individual’s head/upper body, with no visible resistance from the victim.
